SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.start_time, n.end_time, n.status, CASE n.status WHEN 0 THEN '未发布' WHEN 1 THEN '公示中' WHEN 2 THEN '已结束' END AS status_text, u.name AS publisher_name, n.create_time, n.type_id, gt.type_name FROM public_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.user_id AND u.role = 0 LEFT JOIN grant_type gt ON n.type_id = gt.id
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND n.status = #{status}
ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.start_time, n.end_time, n.status, CASE n.status WHEN 0 THEN '未发布' WHEN 1 THEN '公示中' WHEN 2 THEN '已结束' END AS status_text, u.name AS publisher_name, n.create_time, n.type_id, gt.type_name FROM public_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.user_id AND u.role = 0 LEFT JOIN grant_type gt ON n.type_id = gt.id WHERE n.status = 1
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.start_time, n.end_time, n.status, CASE n.status WHEN 0 THEN '未发布' WHEN 1 THEN '公示中' WHEN 2 THEN '已结束' END AS status_text, u.name AS publisher_name, n.create_time, n.update_time, n.type_id, gt.type_name FROM public_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.user_id AND u.role = 0 LEFT JOIN grant_type gt ON n.type_id = gt.id WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT s.name AS student_name, s.student_no, gl.level_name, gl.amount AS grant_amount FROM evaluation_result er INNER JOIN grant_application ga ON er.application_id = ga.id INNER JOIN student s ON er.student_id = s.id INNER JOIN grant_level gl ON er.level_id = gl.id WHERE ga.type_id = #{typeId} AND er.level_id IS NOT NULL AND er.level_id != 0 ORDER BY er.score_rank ASC
